backends.label: Home Assistant Assist + Wyoming intent backend
backends.fit: Best candidate for a mature local voice assistant layer while CTOS keeps action permissions.
ctos_use: fixed CTOS commands through explicit intents
voice I/O separated from CTOS action authority
risks: full Home Assistant stack is heavier than current CTOS V1
EndeavourOS install path needs a container or venv decision
must not expose CTOS Tier 2/Tier 3 actions directly to voice
backends.next_probe: Build an intent adapter from ai/voice_intents_fr.json before installing a long-lived service.

backends.label: Speech-to-Phrase
backends.fit: Better than free dictation for commands like brief, agenda, ouvre desk, ouvre vms. First live test should prefer the official Wyoming container before a local Kaldi/OpenFST toolchain build.
ctos_use: recognize one of the known CTOS phrases
risks: temporary Home Assistant/Wyoming websocket and token-file context still needs to be chosen
requires a generated phrase list and regression samples
backends.next_probe: Run one localhost-only manual recognition loop through the inspected official container before any service.

backends.label: Piper / Wyoming Piper
backends.fit: Current working local replacement for rough espeak-ng feedback, using fr_FR-siwis-medium on the T480.
risks: upstream 1.5.0 is newer than the installed runtime and must be reviewed before upgrade
voice model licensing and attribution are per voice
quality and latency still need an operator French benchmark
backends.next_probe: Keep Piper as default; benchmark it first, then test Kokoro only as a heavier ctos-core quality challenger if needed.

backends.label: Whisper-class open STT
backends.fit: Use for natural French requests and dictation so CTOS is not limited to exact phrase matching.
ctos_use: larger models on ctos-core after hardware/RAM upgrade
risks: must not execute transcript text directly
backends.next_probe: Capture the real French corpus, then compare the existing Wyoming/faster-whisper path with current whisper.cpp using identical audio and native Silero VAD.

backends.label: OpenVoiceOS
backends.fit: Interesting full assistant ecosystem, but broader than CTOS V2 needs.
ctos_use: reference for skill architecture and voice UX
risks: too much platform surface for the current permission model
backends.next_probe: Sandbox only after Assist/Wyoming phrase path is evaluated.

backends.label: Leon
backends.fit: Useful reference for a personal-assistant product shape, not the immediate CTOS backend.
risks: Node stack and assistant framework are not aligned with current CTOS Python tools
would not solve CTOS permission tiers by itself
backends.next_probe: Read as product inspiration, not an install target for V2.
